CORRECTION OF FEBRUARY 19, 2025
CITY COUNCIL JOURNAL OF PROCEEDINGS

Be It Ordained by the City Council of the City of Chicago:

SECTION 1. That ordinance 02025-0014852 reclassifying the area shown on Map Number
5-G, as amended, Application Number 22638T1, for the common address at 2225 North
Dayton Street, which was passed by the City Council on February 19, 2025 and which
was printed in the Journal of the Proceedings of the City Council of the City of Chicago
of said date on pages 24817 through 24826 is hereby corrected by deleting the zoning
district symbol: “RT-4.5 Residential Two Flat, Townhouse and Multi Unit District”
appearing in the 27™ printed line from the top of page 24817 and inserting the zoning
district symbol: “RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District” in lieu thereof and by deleting the
zoning district symbol: “RT-4.5” appearing in the 3", 4", and 5" printed line from the top
of page 24818 and inserting the zoning district symbol: “RM-4.5” in lieu thereof.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall take effect after its passage.

Zoning Administrator

Hatrick nami
